cohort: Women who underwent IVF/ICSI with donor oocytes (n=259) or autologous oocytes (n=515) between 2007 and 2014
finding: Women undergoing IVF/ICSI with donor oocytes had a four times increased risk of gestational hypertensive disorders and pre-eclampsia, a higher rate of cesarean section, and a higher risk of postpartum hemorrhage compared to women using their own oocytes.
mod_finding: Women who gave birth after oocyte donation had a higher rate of cesarean section (AOR 1.69; 95% CI 1.22-2.35).
